name: Flamemon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait and 1 Tamer card with an inherited effect among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand without paying the cost.
